selection_rule: Prefer conveyor-specific and real electromechanical data with clear reuse terms; use generic industrial datasets only as auxiliary transfer or robustness evidence.

datasets.notes: 120 FPS, 1280x720 top-down iron-ore conveyor; normal/anomalous folders and YOLO-style subset. Directly relevant to material-on-belt vision.
Coal/gangue conveyor scenes with dust, wear, occlusion and low-contrast foreign objects such as wood, ropes/nets and bags; official repo includes three training branches and fusion inference.
Sequential industrial conveyor-belt crack dataset; useful for belt-health branch, not for AFR material-flow labels.

datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 reported by dataset project; retain attribution metadata
datasets.notes: 3 audio + 4 vibration channels; normal plus dry lubrication, guide-rail misalignment, chain slack and screw-drop/obstruction; multiple speeds/loads and factory noise.
282 runs x 90 s at 12.8 kHz; synchronized 8-channel measurements; electrical, mechanical and compound faults under steady/transitional working conditions.
Healthy, bearing, rotor, stator and compound fault cases at 12.8 kHz.
Variable speed/load gearbox health, wear, pitting, cracks, broken/missing teeth and compound faults.

28 process faults, 6 operating modes, 500 repeat simulations per fault, transitions/setpoint changes, 100 h simulations sampled every 3 min. Training 01 should stream/sample subsets rather than download all 133 GB immediately.
Real physical test rig; four component conditions with severity grades.

~1M sensor-tag records + ~1M work orders across 37 equipment types including belt conveyor, motor, gearbox and dosing pump; synthetic, therefore used for domain vocabulary/tool planning rather than as factual safety authority.

Industrial asset agent benchmark with IoT, failure-mode/sensor mapping, time-series forecasting/anomaly tools, work orders and vibration analysis. Use as architecture/evaluation corpus; retain FLOWTRUST-specific safety rules.

benchmark_only_or_pending_license.reason: Strong industrial anomaly benchmark but non-commercial CC BY-NC-SA terms; benchmark only.
Large real industrial anomaly corpus but research/non-commercial terms; benchmark only.
Highly relevant industrial video anomaly corpus, but dataset reuse terms must be verified before inclusion in training weights.
